issue.body:
While trying to get my head around the suggestions @tomchristie made in #522, it appears that the example is a little out of date now.

Am I right in understanding that:

```
app.add_middleware(
    DatabaseMiddleware,
    database_url=settings.DATABASE_URL,
    rollback_on_shutdown=settings.TESTING
)
```

...is now:

```
database = databases.Database(settings.DATABASE_URL, force_rollback=settings.TESTING)

@app.on_event("startup")
async def startup():
    await database.connect()

@app.on_event("shutdown")
async def shutdown():
    await database.disconnect()
```

?
issue.title: https://www.starlette.io/config/#a-full-example out of date (DatabaseMiddleware -> Database)?
